rules.title: Generic enum literal takes mangled concrete enum name
rules.statement: When an EnumLit/EnumLitData is monomorphized and its result type is an Enum with non-empty type-args, the emitted enum name is `enum_name` followed by `__<mangle(arg)>` for each type-arg; the concrete enum is recorded as needed. Otherwise the original enum name is kept.

rules.title: Generic struct literal takes concrete (mangled) struct name
rules.statement: When a StructLit is monomorphized and its result type is a Struct/ZonedStruct with non-empty type-args, the emitted struct name is the concrete (monomorphized) struct name; otherwise the original literal name is used. The concrete struct is recorded as needed.

rules.title: Match-arm patterns are type-substituted during monomorphization
rules.statement: Cloning a MatchExpr substitutes types within each arm's pattern (via the current SubstMap) and recursively substitutes scrutinee, guard, and arm-value expressions.

rules.title: type-code-of resolves concrete struct type code else hashes
rules.statement: TypeCodeOf(T): if substituted T still contains a TypeVar (or is null), it stays a runtime type-code-of node. For a concrete Struct/ZonedStruct, the type code is the registered struct's type_code (or matching inst-annotation's). If no registered code, the code is a 56-bit hash of `type_str(T)` biased into [128, ...] (raw<128 → raw+128).
rules.uncertainty: Exact hash construction (type_hash_23 → type_hash_56bit) is delegated to helpers outside this unit.

rules.title: Writ literal value tree is deep-cloned with substituted captures
rules.statement: A WritLit is deep-cloned over its Writ value tree (Null/Bool/Int/Float/Str/Capture/Type/Map/Array), preserving map key-type and int-vs-string keying and array elem-type; capture expressions are recursively substituted and capture types are type-substituted. The static_blob is copied before emit (the emit reuses the moved type-pool arena).

rules.title: $fs... splice-pack folds reflected [Type] producers into call type-args
rules.statement: A call type-arg encoded as TypeVar named `__splicepack$<v>` is resolved by chasing `v` (≤8 VarRef hops) to a producer call and folding its element types into the callee's type-args: `__type_refs_of__` → all (substituted) type-args; `__args_of__` → type-args of the first type-arg T; `__typelist_tail__` → T.type_args[1..]; `__tuple_elems_of__` → T's tuple elements (T must be Tuple); `__field_types_of__` → the (substituted) field types of struct T. An unrecognized producer is a hard error.
rules.divergence: Logos reflection/metaprogramming extension; no Rust equivalent.

rules.title: field-types-of on a non-struct yields an empty type pack
rules.statement: `__field_types_of__` applied to a substituted T that is not a Struct/ZonedStruct yields an empty pack (the [Type;0] result), which resolves variadic instantiation to the 0-arg base overload rather than aborting. Field types of a generic struct are computed by substituting the struct template's type-params with T's type-args.

rules.title: Type/const pack-key in call type-args expands to the bound pack
rules.statement: A call type-arg that is a TypeVar or ConstVar whose name is a key in the active pack map expands to that pack's entries (each localized into the current arena). Otherwise the type-arg is type-substituted normally.

rules.title: sizeof...(T) evaluates to the post-expansion pack length
rules.statement: `__sizeof_pack__` is replaced by an integer literal equal to the number of concrete type-args after pack expansion.

rules.title: type-kind-of yields the kind discriminant of substituted T
rules.statement: `__type_kind_of__` is replaced by an integer literal equal to the LogosType kind discriminant of the concrete substituted first type-arg (0 if none).

rules.title: wstatic-hash-of yields the byte-hash of CFG
rules.statement: `__wstatic_hash_of__` is replaced by an integer literal equal to the const-value (u64 byte-hash) carried by the substituted first type-arg (a WStaticLit kind); 0 if absent.

rules.title: type-hash-of yields a structural layout-stable hash
rules.statement: `__type_hash_of__` is replaced by an integer literal equal to a structural FNV-1a-64 hash of the substituted T (no struct/field names; recurses into field types), i.e. layout-stable identity.

rules.title: type-name-of yields the canonical type string of T
rules.statement: `__type_name_of__` is replaced by a string literal equal to the canonical `type_str(T)` of the concrete substituted T (empty if none).

rules.title: type-uid-of yields the low 64 bits of the nominal type UID
rules.statement: `__type_uid_of__` is replaced by an integer literal equal to the low 64 bits of the nominal UID (derived from a hash of the canonical type id of substituted T); the mapping uid→type is recorded for later reification. `__type_uid_hi_of__` yields the high 64 bits over the same canonical input, so the halves agree.

rules.title: is-same compares two substituted types for equality
rules.statement: `__is_same__` yields a bool literal true iff exactly two type-args are given and they are equal after substitution.

rules.title: Type-trait predicates evaluate on the substituted type's kind
rules.statement: Each predicate yields a bool literal computed from the kind of the concrete substituted first type-arg: __is_ptr__/ref/mut_ref/struct/zoned/enum/tuple/slice/array/bool test the exact kind; __is_integer__ is true for I8..I128/U8..U128; __is_float__ for F32/F64; __is_signed__ for I8..I128; __is_unsigned__ for U8..U128; __is_primitive__ for bool|float|integer.

rules.title: args-count-of yields the number of generic type arguments of T
rules.statement: `__args_count_of__` yields an i64 literal equal to the count of T's generic type-args (0 for non-generic/primitive T).

rules.title: has-trait resolves a trait implementation at monomorphization time
rules.statement: `__has_trait__` yields a bool literal: it reads the trait name from the call's first string-literal argument and the concrete type from type_args[0], reduces T to a concrete name (concrete_struct_name for Struct/ZonedStruct, enum_name for Enum, else type_str, with any `$G...` generic suffix stripped), and recursively tests trait satisfaction against concrete + blanket impl tables.

rules.title: has-trait-of recovers T from a reflected Type value then resolves the trait
rules.statement: `__has_trait_of__(trait, t: Type)` recovers the concrete T from t's StructLit `uid` field (a `__type_uid_of__` call, chasing ≤8 VarRef hops) and then performs the same impl-table recursion as __has_trait__ to yield a bool literal.
